source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    if len(colors) < 2:
        return out
    boxes = {}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        boxes[color] = (min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells))
    inner_color = min(colors, key=lambda color: (boxes[color][2]-boxes[color][0]+1)*(boxes[color][3]-boxes[color][1]+1))
    outer_color = max(colors, key=lambda color: (boxes[color][2]-boxes[color][0]+1)*(boxes[color][3]-boxes[color][1]+1))
    ir0, ic0, ir1, ic1 = boxes[inner_color]
    or0, oc0, or1, oc1 = boxes[outer_color]
    dr = min(ir0-or0, or1-ir1)
    dc = min(ic0-oc0, oc1-ic1)
    r0, r1 = max(0, or0-dr), min(len(grid)-1, or1+dr)
    c0, c1 = max(0, oc0-dc), min(len(grid[0])-1, oc1+dc)
    for r in range(r0, r1+1):
        for c in range(c0, c1+1):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = inner_color
    return out
'''
